messages:
maria (support): FYI Acme support ticket — their finance lead reports 403 on billing console: "You do not have permission to view billing for this org". Started after yesterday's admin delegation refactor. Ticket: INC-5542.

maria (support): quick details from customer: org_id=acme-334, user=carla@acme.com, they can access models but not billing routes. Screenshot attached.

sree (eng-oncall): pinging eng-security + platform. Do we have any audit logs for authz decisions for carla@acme.com? Also need the exact policy change that went out yesterday.

alex (eng-security): I saw the rollout: policy rename from `org.admin` -> `org.admin.v2` and a migration that was supposed to copy bindings. Looks like the migration skipped orgs with custom role mappings (Acme is one). Checking audit.

alex (eng-security): log snippet: `authz: deny org=acme-334 user=carla@acme.com reason=missing_permission billing.view (mapped role: org.admin -> no binding)`

josh (platform): ok. So customer roles exist but the effective role binding lost `billing.view`. We should avoid global rebind. I can craft a targeted backfill to add `billing.view` to any principal that had `org.admin` before the rename. Need approval to run for acme-334.

maria (support): Customer authorized targeted fix for their org only. They've asked for ETA and rollback plan.

sree (eng-oncall): Safety checklist: 1) take current role_binding snapshot for acme-334; 2) run backfill in dry-run mode; 3) run live; 4) verify via impersonation token. Also notify compliance.

alex (eng-security): Agreed. Dry-run SQL:
```
-- dry run: list principals missing billing.view after rename
SELECT principal_id FROM role_bindings rb
LEFT JOIN roles r ON rb.role_id = r.id
WHERE rb.org_id = 'acme-334' AND r.name = 'org.admin.v2' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.role_id = r.id AND p.name = 'billing.view'
);
```

josh (platform): Run the dry-run now against staging copy of bindings. Will post results.

deploy-bot: staging backfill dry-run completed for org=acme-334. 3 principals would be updated.

josh (platform): Dry-run shows 3 principals: svcacct:billing-agent, user:carla@acme.com, user:dan@acme.com. Matches what support saw. Ready to run live after snapshots.

sree (eng-oncall): Snapshot path: s3://rbac-snapshots/acme-334/1959876543.json. I created it.

josh (platform): Running live backfill now. Command: `./tools/rbac_backfill --org acme-334 --add-perm billing.view --commit`

deploy-bot: running job rbac-backfill-557 (org=acme-334). Started 1959876598.

deploy-bot: job rbac-backfill-557 completed 1959876622. 3 principals updated.

alex (eng-security): I verified permission check logs: `authz: allow org=acme-334 user=carla@acme.com permission=billing.view via role org.admin.v2`.

maria (support): Customer confirms Carla can now see billing page. She says "thanks, looks fixed". Closing on their end.

sree (eng-oncall): Post-action items: 1) schedule migration fix for orgs with custom mappings; 2) add alert for any policy rename that leaves orgs unmigrated; 3) add unit test to migration script.

josh (platform): I'll open a short RFC and a follow-up JIRA: MIG-421 (add idempotent rebind), and ADD-832 (alerting).

alex (eng-security): Also recommending we add an audit query to detect missing perms after any RBAC refactor and run nightly until migration is completed.

maria (support): I'll update the support ticket and paste rollback snapshot link. Also ping customer success for postmortem email.

sree (eng-oncall): Closing thread: incident resolved, customer access restored. We'll run the migration patch across affected orgs in a controlled window next week. :white_check_mark:
